title: OpenAIProxy
description: supabase/functions/openai-proxy/index.ts. POST only. Same shape/pattern as anthropic-proxy: transparent reverse proxy of OpenAI's POST /v1/chat/completions, validating only `model` (allowlist) and capping `max_tokens`. Streaming responses are metered by an input-token estimate (OpenAI does not return usage on a stream without stream_options) that deliberately skips image_url content parts (charged a flat ~1024-token allowance instead) so a base64 image can't blow the estimate.

OpenAIProxyRequest.title: OpenAIProxyRequest
OpenAIProxyRequest.description: Passthrough of the OpenAI chat/completions request body; only model and max_tokens are inspected server-side.

model.title: OpenAIProxyModel
model.description: Server-side allowlist (ALLOWED_MODELS) — treat as a live value to re-derive from source, not frozen.

messages.description: Passed through unchanged; shape follows the OpenAI chat/completions messages array (role + content, where content may be a string or an array of {type, text} / {type: image_url, image_url} parts).
